description: Autonomous AI software company with CEO/CTO/PM/HR/BA + 17 FAANG specialists and a Google/Ahrefs/DataForSEO SEO division (18 SEO sub-agents + 25 SEO skills). Reviewer runs a measurement pass (file/function length, cross-file duplicate scan, drift diff) instead of grading by impression. Frontend visual-craft skill pack (ui-ux-pro-max design intelligence, frontend-design, shadcn/ui, Tailwind v4 patterns, Figma-to-code, design tokens) and backend skill pack (API/DB design, PostgreSQL + optimization, Redis, real-time WS/SSE, GraphQL, API security/audit, Docker, observability) wired as on-demand lazySkills, validation gates, and Git auto-checkpointing.
